identity_and_packing.node_ids: unchanged integer identities from the authenticated sparse detection cache
identity_and_packing.transition_membership: exact same required endpoint union and 1024-token selected node membership as the frozen forward cache
identity_and_packing.node_order: exact forward selected-node order; endpoint lookup is by immutable node_id, never by matrix transpose
identity_and_packing.missing_required_endpoint: fail entire video; never zero-fill or omit a row

genuine_reverse_inference.model_interface: frozen Trackastra TrackingTransformer with twelve zero-filled wrfeat channels
genuine_reverse_inference.per_transition_time_map: for every packed node i, t_rev[i] = min(t_original) + max(t_original) - t_original[i]; z,y,x and node_id are unchanged
genuine_reverse_inference.execution: run a new model forward pass on coords=[t_rev,z,y,x], then call the pinned quiet_softmax normalize_output with t_rev
prohibited_shortcuts: duplication or scalar recalibration of any forward field
reindexing without a separately executed reversed-time model pass

no_link.meaning: quiet_softmax implicit null mass for original source u having no returned successor among packed original t+1 endpoints
no_link.candidate_set: all packed nodes at exactly original t+1; spatially invalid entries are already zero under pinned normalize_output
no_link.numeric_guard: require the un-clipped value in [-1e-6,1+1e-6], then clip only roundoff to [0,1]; otherwise fail

division_and_boundary_behavior.division: return each parent-child endpoint independently; reverse normalization may make siblings compete, so cycle evidence must never be a hard veto or delete one daughter solely for disagreement
division_and_boundary_behavior.no_merge: the supplier does not create edges, merges, or actions
division_and_boundary_behavior.first_or_last_frame: only adjacent transitions represented in the frozen population are emitted; absent adjacent frames produce no row, not a synthetic null row

row_aligned_output.container: one deterministic compressed NPZ per video plus a canonical-JSON manifest

arrays.cycle_sign_agreement: uint8 [row_count], signs agree with zero treated as nonnegative

determinism_and_provenance.repeat_witness: repeat the lexicographically first 44b6 video with nonempty transitions and require array_equal for every emitted array
manifest_hashes: forward report and every forward video

controls_after_supplier_freeze.disabled_cycle_beta: set every reverse-derived descriptor exactly to zero while retaining identical rows and capacity
controls_after_supplier_freeze.permutation_control: use the existing frozen separation contract's within-video, within-transition deterministic returned-reverse permutation; do not permute identities or forward fields
controls_after_supplier_freeze.outcome_gate: unchanged five-fold B0/A1/A0 separation contract; no outcome is authorized by this contract alone
